quest.title: Jade Chamber Rising
quest.description: Liyue Harbor is all abuzz with the news of the Jade Chamber's rebuilding. Go to Yujing Terrace and ask Ningguang for the details.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x425, Mora x15325, Adventurer's Experience x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

chapter.title: The Crane Returns on the Wind

talks.objective: Go to Yujing Terrace to listen to Ningguang's speech

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I have gathered everyone here today to make an important announcement.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Perhaps some of you will have heard the news already. I am, in fact, planning to rebuild the Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Hongfei
dialogues.text: Rebuild the Jade Chamber? That's a huge project...

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: So the rumors are true. No wonder the price of building materials has gone up so much lately.

dialogues.speaker: Zhicheng
dialogues.text: The Jade Chamber means a lot to Lady Ningguang. Getting involved in this would be a huge opportunity...

dialogues.speaker: Hongfei
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang, is there any way we can be of service?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Patience. Since the news made it out a few days ago, I have already had many people contacting me to declare an interest in joining the project.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, I do have a few matters I should like to entrust to you here today.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The building site has been chosen, and most of the materials have been assembled. Three key items are, however, still outstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: They are as follows: Sunset Vermillionite, Wonder Cores, and Adepti Sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: Uh... Excuse my ignorance, Lady Ningguang. I'm familiar enough with Plaustrite, but I've never even heard of those other two.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Only sufficiently large pieces of Plaustrite — or specifically, Vermillionite — may earn themselves the "Sunset" moniker. This stone is what allows the Jade Chamber to float. Wonder Cores, meanwhile, are the central components of the mechanical structure of the Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Adepti Sigils serve as a means of integrating the mechanical devices with adepti art. They are as indispensable as the mechanical core itself.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Although these three items are rare, I trust that with your connections and capabilities, procuring them will not be a question of "if," but of "when."

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I take the saying "Time is money" more seriously than most. Efficiency is everything. I will pay a generous price for the materials that you find, and in addition, the first three people who collect all the materials will have the opportunity to ask me a question.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You may ask me anything, and I will give you an honest answer. I trust that this means of compensation will be to everyone's satisfaction.

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: These things won't be easy to get hold of, but if it means a chance to get some inside information on Liyue Harbor's development plan for next year...

dialogues.speaker: Zhicheng
dialogues.text: ...Then it's the deal of a lifetime. Information from Lady Ningguang is priceless. Whoever gets to it first takes the market...

dialogues.speaker: Hongfei
dialogues.text: Haha, what a coincidence! I won't divulge too much, but I heard some murmurings about some Plaustrite just the other day. So excuse me, all, but I have some business to do!

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: Ah, no... We'd better move quickly, or this opportunity will be snatched away from us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ningguang's rebuilding the Jade Chamber!? This is a huge deal. Let's get involved!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: So you heard my announcement, did you? What do you think? Interested?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I really ask you anything at all?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Yes, providing the question pertains to something I am knowledgeable about.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #(Maybe I can find out more about my {F#brother}{M#sister}...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Ooh, then Paimon will ask you about how to run a business!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we will never be short of Mora ever again!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Hehe, of course. But how much information I share with you will depend on your performance.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The construction of the Jade Chamber requires a great deal of space. The abandoned mine outside the Golden House has been selected as the building site. Once you have collected the materials, please take them there.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I have other business to attend to now, otherwise I would gladly escort you to the site in person. When you do arrive, please seek out my secretary.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Remember, this is a race against the clock. A rare opportunity presents itself to you... Do not let somebody else snatch it from your grasp.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ningguang seems super busy... C'mon, we'd better get going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #First we gotta get out of Yujing Terrace... Huh? Look, {NICKNAME}, it seems like there's something kinda fishy going on over there.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Ma'am, you seem like an eminent and distinguished young lady to me. I can see that you're easily gonna win this procurement contest Lady Ningguang has set up.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: As it happens, we have some information about the materials that I really think might interest you. Come on, let's find somewhere a little more private, and we can get down to brass tacks...
No. I don't need it.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Aww, don't be like that. Hey, come on, don't go!

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Well don't just stand there, after her!

dialogues.speaker: Qiang the Brave
dialogues.text: Oh, right, yeah!

talks.objective: Follow the "information peddlers" to figure out what's going on

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: The rebuilding of the Jade Chamber is a monumental task, and we are the ones who have been entrusted with this work. It is only right that we put our hearts and souls into this project.

talks.objective: Observe the disagreement between the unknown young lady and the information peddlers

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Hehe. Well, will you look at that, Ma'am. Nowhere left to run.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Don't worry. We're not bad guys. You give us some Mora, we give you a little info, everybody's a winner.

dialogues.speaker: Qiang the Brave
dialogues.text: Boss, I got a bad feeling about this. Look at her, the white hair, the energy she gives off... I'm telling you, there's something different about her...

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: So what? She's loaded! How are we ever going to repay those gambling debts if we just let money walk away from us, huh?
I've already told you. I don't need your information.
If you still can't grasp that, I'm happy to repeat it in a way that won't be so easy to forget.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Come on, Ma'am. You seem like an intelligent lady. I shouldn't have to spell this out to you.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: It's not about whether you need the info or not, okay? It's about you taking out your money and handing it over and nobody getting hurt.
I won't—

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: No more excuses! I know you have money. I saw you.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Yeah, I saw you, strolling into Liuli Pavilion, ordering a table full of food, and only taking a few bites.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: Then Xinyue Kiosk, then Wanmin Restaurant. Same story each time — you order all the signature dishes, take a few bites, then you're on your way again.

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: How could you afford to be so wasteful if you weren't from a rich family? And since you're so rich, what's the loss to you in giving us a little spare change, huh?
Master warned me not to lay a hand on anyone in Liyue Harbor...
But here we are. Perhaps... Yes. Let's call it "fate."

dialogues.speaker: Qiang the Brave
dialogues.text: Boss, I'm telling you, something's not right...

dialogues.speaker: Scar Liu
dialogues.text: What are you afraid of? We're just selling information, it's not illegal. If she lays a finger on us, all the better — we'll sue her for everything she's worth!

response.speaker: Zheng
response.text: Oh? You again.

response.speaker: Scar Liu
response.text: The Millelith? Wh—What are the Millelith doing here? Did you do this? Hmph! You oughta mind your own business! I swear—

response.speaker: Zheng
response.text: Silence! How dare you threaten innocent civilians! You're coming with us!

response.speaker: Scar Liu
response.text: Hehe... Don't be angry, Sir. Please, let me explain.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The Millelith takes away the hooligans who were surrounding the young lady with white hair.
...Shenhe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Shenhe?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: My name.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ohh, so your name's Shenhe! Paimon's name is... well, Paimon! And this is Paimon's travel buddy, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I've heard about you two before. Thank you for helping to defuse the situation.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I could've dealt with it myself, though. I suspect smashing his head against the ground a handful of times is all it would have taken to get him to surrender.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaaah! Y—You can't do that! That's way too violent!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is Liyue Harbor. There are laws against that kinda stuff you know!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...Laws?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have you not heard of the law, Shenhe?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: No. Apparently not.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really!? So how exactly have you—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Um... What was that noise...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: That would be my stomach growling. I haven't eaten enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's so honest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, that's right — they said you went around all the restaurants ordering this and that and the other, but only took a small bite of each dish...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then of course you're still hungry! So... anything in particular you're hungry for?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Qingxin, Glaze Lily, Violetgrass. These are my usuals.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Those are all medicinal herbs...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: ...Medicinal herbs?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kinda hard to explain... Anyway, Bubu Pharmacy's not far away. Let's take Shenhe there for a big medicinal meal!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After all, you can't work on an empty stomach!

choices.text: They're trying to intimidate people into doing business.

talks.objective: Bring Shenhe to Bubu Pharmacy to purchase medicines

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Are you here to buy some herbs? I do hope you brought your prescription?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Qingxin, Glaze Lily, and Violetgrass, please. Half a pound of each.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: What kind of prescription is this? Sounds more like a lunch order, hah... Oh, here you go, that's everything we have in stock.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's... really eating them...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: To everyone's astonishment, Shenhe polishes off all the medicinal herbs.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: My hunger has now abated. Thank you.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Rather awful.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Though they were not completely devoid of sweet fragrance, after consuming a large quantity of them, bitterness is all that remains.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...So how come you chow down on these and barely touch the restaurant food?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon had enough Mora, Paimon would go to the fanciest restaurant in town, and order a whole table of food, and eat it all in one go!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Because I'm not sure whether I will remain here in the future.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: The food of the mortal realm is most delicious. But should I return to the mountains, yearning for the food here shall only pose an obstacle to my continued spiritual development.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Sampling each dish in order to appreciate its taste is enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #"Return to the mountains"... That proves it. {NICKNAME}! Paimon knew she was an adeptus!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Enough about me. What are your plans from here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right! Paimon almost forgot. We came out to take part in the rebuild-the-Jade-Chamber competition!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And... and now we're probably super behind because we've been held up for so long...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I see. I heard something about the contest when I was passing by.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe... Yep, you get to ask Ningguang any question you want if you win!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Were you interested in the contest too, Shenhe?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I came for the rebuilding of the Jade Chamber. But until this point, I had no intention of joining a contest.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: However, you have shown me your kindness, and I would now like to lend you my assistance. Don't worry. I ask for nothing in return.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! You really don't have to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...but having an adeptus help out will make things a whole lot easier, so...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Then let's not delay. I have a plan.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! Paimon bets this is gonna be the awesomest plan ever!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I am not sure whether, or to what extent, this plan can be classified as "awesome." I do, however, believe it will be highly effective.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: We simply need to dispose of everyone who is currently ahead of us. Then, we alone shall become the victors.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Veto! That is not acceptable, not by a long shot!

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Really? But I hear that competition is in essence about conflict and one-upmanship...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, we want to win this competition fair and square, okay!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sunset Vermillionite, Wonder Cores, and Adepti Sigils... Let's start at the top of the list and work down. So for Plaustrite—

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I was wondering who I could hear arguing over there. So, it's you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Baizhu! What are you doing out here?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Lady Ningguang wishes to purchase a large batch of wound dressing. We're running low at the store, so I came out to fetch the ingredients personally.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? How come Lady Ningguang needs so much wound dressing all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: I'm not too sure. I did hear that she's looking to rebuild the Jade Chamber, maybe for its first aid on site? I didn't ask, though — far be it from me to pry into my customers' personal affairs.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Oh, and she also borrowed Qiqi... meaning Bubu Pharmacy is very short-handed right now. I don't suppose any of you are looking for part-time work, by any chance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, no, we've got other stuff to do... While you're here, though, you seem to know a lot — have you ever heard of something called "Sunset Vermillionite"?

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: Ah, the variety of Plaustrite used in the Jade Chamber, yes? There is some mention of it in the "Seven Mountain Treatises." When activated, Sunset Vermillionite rises up all the way into the clouds. It's very rare indeed.

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: As far as the records show, virtually all Sunset Vermillionite in existence has been mined and taken possession of. But the Feiyun Commerce Guild would know far more about this than I do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay then! Let's go ask at the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Baizhu!

response.speaker: Baizhu
response.text: You're quite welcome. Good luck to you all, and if there's anything further you need from me, just come to Bubu Pharmacy.

choices.text: We welcome you to our team.

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: First, we construct the keel of the Jade Chamber. The keel is the part that holds the Plaustrite, so once that arrives, it goes straight in...

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: Normally, it would be Lady Keqing supervising the construction work. But it seems like she's been a little preoccupied lately...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Why does Lady Ningguang need so much wound dressing?

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Is it really such risky business, rebuilding the Jade Chamber? This is all most peculiar...

dialogues.speaker: Lizheng
dialogues.text: Shh... Quiet! Can't you see that I'm concentrating here? Every brick is a crucial component! If I stop concentrating, I'm gonna lay a brick out of whack, and that'll put the whole darn structure out of whack, and then... Well, shoot, and then it's all over...

dialogues.speaker: Siqin
dialogues.text: I'm under orders to ensure the security of this location. It's imperative that construction stays on schedule. Hopefully, there won't be any setbacks.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: We've been pretty active in the Millelith recently. I don't know what's going on but... I'd better be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: This is a matter of utmost importance. I must not let Lady Ningguang down...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Oh? Are you here to deliver construction materials?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Did you hear that, {NICKNAME}? They said they had some useful information!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Information's just what we need right now. Let's follow them and see what we can find out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... They're not here. Let's keep looking.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Psst! {NICKNAME}! Do you think Shenhe might be an adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems like it's her first time in Liyue Harbor, and she doesn't seem to get how things work here... If she's an adeptus, that would explain everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where does she fit in with the other adepti, though? Paimon's super curious...
